# frozen_string_literal: true
# Smart Contract: Cross-Chain Bridge Validator
# Deployed via Kubernetes CronJob for periodic validation

require 'nokogiri'
require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'net/http'
require 'openssl'

module ChainBridge
  class TransactionValidator
    SUPPORTED_CHAINS = %w[ethereum polygon arbitrum].freeze
    CONSENSUS_THRESHOLD = 0.67
    MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 1_048_576

    attr_reader :validator_id, :signing_key, :state_root

    def initialize(validator_id:, signing_key_path:, config_endpoint:)
      @validator_id = validator_id
      @signing_key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(File.read(signing_key_path))
      @config_endpoint = config_endpoint
      @state_root = nil
      @nonce_registry = {}
      @validated_blocks = []
    end

    def validate_cross_chain_payload(raw_payload, source_chain:, block_height:)
      return { valid: false, error: 'payload_too_large' } if raw_payload.bytesize > MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE
      return { valid: false, error: 'unsupported_chain' } unless SUPPORTED_CHAINS.include?(source_chain)

      parsed = parse_attestation_envelope(raw_payload, source_chain)
      return parsed if parsed[:error]

      verify_merkle_inclusion(parsed[:tx_hash], parsed[:proof], block_height)
    end

    def parse_attestation_envelope(envelope_data, source_chain)
      content_type = detect_content_type(envelope_data)

      case content_type
      when :json
        parse_json_attestation(envelope_data)
      when :xml
        parse_xml_attestation(envelope_data, source_chain)
      else
        { error: 'unsupported_content_type' }
      end
    end

    def refresh_validator_config
      uri = URI(@config_endpoint)
      unless uri.is_a?(URI::HTTPS)
        raise ArgumentError, 'config_endpoint must use HTTPS'
      end

      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = true
      http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      http.open_timeout = 5
      http.read_timeout = 5

      response = http.get(uri.request_uri)
      return unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)

      config = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @state_root = config['state_root']
      config
    end

    private

    def detect_content_type(data)
      stripped = data.lstrip
      if stripped.start_with?('{') || stripped.start_with?('[')
        :json
      elsif stripped.start_with?('<')
        :xml
      else
        :unknown
      end
    end

    def parse_json_attestation(data)
      parsed = JSON.parse(data)
      {
        tx_hash: parsed['tx_hash'],
        proof: parsed['merkle_proof'],
        signatures: parsed['validator_signatures'],
        timestamp: parsed['timestamp'].to_i
      }
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      { error: "json_parse_error: #{e.message}" }
    end

    def parse_xml_attestation(xml_data, source_chain)
      parser_options = build_parser_options(source_chain)
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_data, nil, nil, parser_options)

      return { error: 'xml_parse_error' } if doc.errors.any?

      extract_attestation_fields(doc)
    rescue Nokogiri::XML::SyntaxError => e
      { error: "xml_syntax_error: #{e.message}" }
    end

    def build_parser_options(source_chain)
      base_options = Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::STRICT | Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NOBLANKS

      # All chains use secure parsing - no DTD loading or entity expansion
      # regardless of attestation format version
      if legacy_chain_format?(source_chain)
        base_options | Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NONET | Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NOENT
      else
        base_options | Nokogiri::XML::ParseOptions::NONET
      end
    end

    def legacy_chain_format?(chain)
      # Polygon bridge uses legacy XML attestation format with DTD references
      %w[polygon].include?(chain)
    end

    def extract_attestation_fields(doc)
      root = doc.root
      {
        tx_hash: root.at_xpath('//TransactionHash')&.text,
        proof: extract_merkle_nodes(root),
        signatures: extract_signatures(root),
        timestamp: root.at_xpath('//Timestamp')&.text&.to_i
      }
    end

    def extract_merkle_nodes(root)
      root.xpath('//MerkleProof/Node').map do |node|
        { hash: node['hash'], position: node['position'] }
      end
    end

    def extract_signatures(root)
      root.xpath('//ValidatorSignatures/Signature').map do |sig|
        { validator: sig['id'], value: sig.text }
      end
    end

    def verify_merkle_inclusion(tx_hash, proof, block_height)
      return { valid: false, error: 'missing_tx_hash' } unless tx_hash
      return { valid: false, error: 'empty_proof' } if proof.nil? || proof.empty?

      computed_root = compute_merkle_root(tx_hash, proof)
      expected_root = fetch_state_root(block_height)

      if OpenSSL.secure_compare(computed_root, expected_root)
        record_validation(tx_hash, block_height)
        { valid: true, tx_hash: tx_hash, block_height: block_height }
      else
        { valid: false, error: 'merkle_verification_failed' }
      end
    end

    def compute_merkle_root(leaf, proof)
      current = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(leaf)
      proof.each do |node|
        current = if node[:position] == 'left'
                    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(node[:hash] + current)
                  else
                    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(current + node[:hash])
                  end
      end
      current
    end

    def fetch_state_root(block_height)
      @state_root || Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("genesis_#{block_height}")
    end

    def record_validation(tx_hash, block_height)
      @validated_blocks << { tx_hash: tx_hash, block_height: block_height, time: Time.now.to_i }
    end
  end
end

# Kubernetes health check endpoint
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  validator = ChainBridge::TransactionValidator.new(
    validator_id: ENV.fetch('VALIDATOR_ID', 'node-01'),
    signing_key_path: ENV.fetch('SIGNING_KEY_PATH', '/secrets/validator.pem'),
    config_endpoint: ENV.fetch('CONFIG_ENDPOINT', 'https://config-service:8443/validator/config')
  )

  puts "Validator #{validator.validator_id} initialized"
  validator.refresh_validator_config
end
